cues.text: Hello, how may I help you?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Well, I’ve been seeing these yellow boxes in front of a lot of houses in my neighbourhood. I just wondered what they were for. I noticed your phone number on all of them, so I called. Could you tell me about your business?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: We do do recycling, but we’re not a business. Gaea’s Guardians is a non-profit group. We encourage recycling as a way of protecting the environment.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: I don’t know. I mean it is a good idea. But I really don’t read the newspaper every day or anything.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: And we don’t come collect newspaper every day! In fact, we only do pickups every other week.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh, well then maybe I could help. I mean in my neighbourhood, there’s too much rubbish lying around everywhere. I’d like to help out, I guess.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: That’s great, sir. You’re doing the right thing. OK, I need to get your contact information. What is your name, please?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Peter Wisrough..
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Peter... how do you spell your last name? W-I-S-R-O-W?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: No, actually it’s W-I-S-R-O-U-G-H.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Oh, I’m sorry. I’m a terrible speller.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: You’re a good speller. It’s just that my family are terrible pronouncers!
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: You’re quite a card, Peter! OK, now what’s your address?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: No. 168 Bridge Road. That’s here in London. How about if I have any questions?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I'm sending you a copy of our booklet, too.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: The booklet has our phone number and email address helpline@blackcat.com. That's H-E-L-P-L-I-N-E at B-L-A-C-K-C-A-T dot com.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: But I nearly forgot to ask, what’s your postcode?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: BS97PU
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: PS97BU?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: No. That’s B as in “boy"-S-9-7-P as in “Peter”-U.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: So, I’m guessing those yellow boxes I saw are for recycled newspapers?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, that is correct, and it’s free of charge.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Wow, that’s good news! Do you recycle anything besides newspaper?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Oh yes, we recycle most everything. Glass, plastic, paper...
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Oh, so I can put like glass and plastic bottles in the box?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Sorry again. Things like that you have to bring to our collection centre.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: And where is that?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Our main centre isn’t that far from you. It’s actually right on the East Side of Central Park
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: That new blue building?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: That’s the one!
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Cool. Hey, what’s with all those different coloured boxes outside that place?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Oh, that’s for the different materials we recycle. The blue is for metal, the green is for glass and plastics, and the yellow of course is for paper.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Hm, okay. I’ll try and manage to keep all that straight.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Oh, no need, they’re each labelled.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Great. So which one would I put magazines in?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Actually, they don’t go in any of the bins. Unfortunately, magazines can’t be recycled because of the material they’re made of. It’s such a waste.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: So would you be interested in volunteering?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Um, I’ll think about it. Could you send me some more info?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Absolutely. Along with the newspaper box, I’ll be sending you our booklet, “ Savvy", that is S-A-double V-Y. It tells you about what you can do to protect the environment in your daily life. Plus it lists things you can do as a volunteer with our group.
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Hey, that’s cool, thanks!
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: My pleasure. Do you have any other questions or concerns?
cues.speaker: WOMAN

cues.text: Nope, that’s it!
cues.speaker: MAN
